A data row with more cells than the header widens the separator so no cell is silently dropped

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td><td>3</td></tr></table>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
